decisions.reason: Turnaround management is central to the firm's integrated, data-driven airside strategy and is prominently presented on its own page.
Apron connectivity enables the integrated platform and the hardware data link, though it could eventually be folded into a broader suite.
Billing software sits further from the operational core but still provides recurring software revenue and supports end-to-end airport offerings.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed docking and apron hardware and strengthens the growing maintenance and service business.
Apron resource management complements turnaround and planning tools and reinforces the integrated software suite.
